features.name: Forest Park Miniature Railroad Trinity Park Depot
features.description: The Trinity Park Depot is the north boarding platform for the Forest Park Miniature Railroad, a weather-dependent five-mile family train ride that crosses the Trinity River, follows the park corridor, and includes a midway snack stop.

details.imageAlt: Forest Park Miniature Railroad Trinity Park Depot at Trinity Park

features.name: Trinity Park Duck Pond
features.description: Trinity Park Duck Pond is the park's named two-acre pond and wildlife-viewing stop, bordered by a walking path, mature trees, nearby parking, and the miniature railroad route.
